mechanism: Sumatriptan combined with tranylcypromine (MAOI) creates severe risk of serotonin syndrome due to excessive serotonergic activity, as both drugs increase serotonin levels through different mechanisms.
action: Contraindicated combination; sumatriptan must not be used within 14 days of discontinuing tranylcypromine; if serotonin syndrome develops, discontinue both agents immediately and provide supportive care.
